scripts.heroku-postbuild: echo 'Verifying Chrome...' && node -e "const p=require('puppeteer');const fs=require('fs');const ep=p.executablePath();console.log('Chrome at:',ep);if(!fs.existsSync(ep)){console.log('Not found, installing...');require('child_process').execSync('npx puppeteer browsers install chrome',{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('Installed at:',p.executablePath())}else{console.log('Chrome OK')}" || echo 'Chrome verify failed'
